address: rue de la Goffe 8, Liège, 4000, Belgium
bio: A nostalgic friendly vibe and good food are the backbone of this inviting local version of a “bouchon lyonnais”. The traditional, extensive menu takes you back in time with dishes such as confit of duck and salardaise potatoes or boulets à la liégoise (meatballs) – among the best in town! Heartwarming, no-nonsense food, served generously and prepared with respect for time-honoured recipes. Spot on every time....
